race.comment: The well-related GRAM (4) (full to G3 winner Zulfiqar) has strung three wins together on the bounce and is racing very consistently in recent times. Gets 3kg off with the claim and should get a gun run from the inside marble. Can continue the picket fence. Former Victorian ESHA (12) just missed the frame when having the first run for the new yard and will have come on with that outing now in the locker. Capable of sharp improvement. BIANCELLI (6) is yet to miss a place in six attempts over this sprint journey and will be ready to peak now third run back. Top-three candidate. ROSE NOIR (8) will be rock-hard fit for this and may earn some minor money. CAT CALL (1) goes well for hoop Lerena and looks one for the exotics.
